name: ADX
description: ADX (Average Directional Index) - measures trend strength. Values above 25 indicate strong trend, below 20 indicate weak/ranging market.

fields.label: Symbol
fields.description: The ticker symbol for the asset being analyzed (e.g. AAPL, BTCUSDT).

fields.label: Timeframe
fields.description: The timeframe/interval of the candle data (e.g. 1m, 5m, 1h, 1d).

fields.label: ADX Period
fields.description: Period for ADX calculation. Higher values smooth out noise but lag more.
